name: Comet Punch
description: You strike out with a lightning fast punch. Make a melee attack roll. The target takes {dice} {type} damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, you may immediately hit again for an additional 1d4 {type} damage. Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional hits.
